items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The second week was with a quintet with me, Miles, John Lewis, Al McKibbon, and Max.

ctx.x: Supposedly, Mulligan wanted to get him on the Birth of the Cool Band, playing clarinet, but he was on the road with Thornhill, and then he died.
Ah, and Miles wanted to get Sonny Stitt.
I don’t want to get ahead of our selves but I’d definitely like to talk about that a little bit.
